properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 7:45AM PDT until October 22 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is occuring or expected soon.

* WHERE...Southwestern Ventura County Ventura County in southwestern
California...

* WHEN...Until 1100 AM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 744 AM PDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small
stream flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Oxnard, Thousand Oaks, Ventura, Camarillo, Ojai, Moorpark, Santa
Paula, Port Hueneme, Ventura Harbor, Point Mugu, Point Mugu State
Park, Newbury Park, La Conchita, El Rio, Silver Strand Beach,
Naval Base Ventura County, Somis, Solimar Beach and Meiners Oaks.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 AM PDT THIS MORNING
